name: Prakash Woollen & Synthetic Mills Limited
about: Prakash Woollen & Synthetic Mills Limited manufactures and sells mink blankets and bed covers in India. The company offers cloudy blankets, such as orchid blankets, and jasmine blankets; soft blankets and baby blankets. It also provides natural fibers, and man-made fibers; spinning, weaving, knitting, and dyeing and finishing; and garment design, cutting and sewing, branding, and packaging services. It sells its products through wholesale, retail, agents, physical stores, and E-commerce platforms. The company was formerly known as Prakash Woollen Mills Limited and changed its name to Prakash Woollen & Synthetic Mills Limited in July 2015. Prakash Woollen & Synthetic Mills Limited was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Moradabad, India.
